title: C04: Decide maintained roles for NFcore, NFcore2 and NFnext

source.contract: Consolidate NFcore2 capabilities into NFnext while retaining NFcore as production default (method='nf' and selectable method='nfcore'), lowerPatternToNFsim for NFcore input, and containing unpromoted NFcore2 as an in-tree test oracle.

oracle.identity: Pinned native NFsim (9b00d42f), in-repo NFcore comparator, analytical continuous-time Markov chain laws, and Catch2 architecture contracts
oracle.law: Detailed balance for reversible isomerization, exponential decay for pure death, exact trajectory parity between method='nf' and method='nfcore' on deterministic seeds, and fail-closed refusal of unpromoted method='nfcore2'.
